title: O shiny que piscou (e ninguém estava olhando)
concept: Paranormal night-vision trail-cam story: a shiny blinks in the dark grass for one second while nobody is watching; then a giant purple robotic eye opens ('Mas alguém estava.') and the real Shiny Muk print proves it: 'pena que n vi piscar / tava afk'.

music.note: 80s horror-synth arpeggio break -> tape-stop silence -> synthwave drop on the eye

claims: detecção de shinys, megas e bosses
alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp

notes: Kept the concept's narration and payoff line ('Ninguém viu. Mas o KizuBot pegou.'); added the twist line 'Mas alguém estava.' with a drawn robotic eye (illustration, not a screenshot). The Shiny Muk card is shown cropped to the sprite + name (stats rows left out, meaning unchanged); the quote crop is verbatim. Caption 'Shiny Muk. Dono AFK.' paraphrases the print ('tava afk'). Visual: night-vision trail-cam footage to vary the F15 series look. Caption under the print sets the customer's words verbatim: 'Shiny Muk. "tava afk"'.
